overview: Caledon had 76,581 residents in 2021, up 15.2% from 66,502 in 2016, living in 23,699 occupied homes across 688.82 square kilometres. That pace of growth is well above the Ontario average, and new subdivisions keep adding households.

The town is large and spread out, with Bolton as its biggest community and many smaller villages. Logistics, manufacturing and construction firms bring jobs, while new residents are still choosing local providers for everything from childcare to home services.

byService.website-development: A Caledon website should map service areas clearly and make quotes easy to request, since customers may be a long drive apart across rural roads.
byService.branding: Branding in Caledon can balance its rural village character with the busy logistics and construction economy, appealing to both long-time residents and newcomers.
